Healthcare 7%, Tech 6% and Financials 1% are your only genuine ballast — that is thin, and it is why my top two ideas sit outside AI entirely.
positions: NVDA is your anchor at 18% of the book and still climbing — up 3.2% since you bought and rising again today, no reason to touch it.

LLY is your worst position at -7.8% and reports tomorrow; the company raised full-year revenue guidance to $82-85 billion in April, so I want to hear the update before judging it.
actions: Hold all 15 positions through this week's earnings — do nothing today.
Trim $180 of NET at market on August 7 if higher.
Buy $180 of BRK-B below $500 instead if it drops there.
risks: Three-quarters of your money is one AI-datacenter bet, so a single bad earnings print can hit many names at once — CEG closing below $228 after August 6 is my warning line.
LLY reports tomorrow already down 7.8%; a cut to its full-year $82-85 billion revenue guidance would be a real business problem, not a price wiggle.
